name: The Tale Will Tell of You

system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You call your companion’s name with all the certainty of someone who has not finished their story.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One ally within 4 squares after it enters Dying.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Your voice reaches it through the noise. If it can hear, it may immediately spend one of its own Grit to regain full HP. The wound remains. Cannot interrupt Last Words; grants no Grit and cannot be used when none remains.
